answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny therefore loses 26 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the vertex decay curve is applied at close, the signal weight of every idle key falls, and the canyon history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 69% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
